developmentBacklogAdded.name: Fresh-post competition decay
developmentBacklogAdded.problem: A very fresh freelance post can look attractive while proposal count rises rapidly enough to erase its application advantage within hours.
developmentBacklogAdded.improvement: Track published age together with proposal-band velocity and automatically lower priority when competition growth outpaces freshness benefit.

developmentBacklogAdded.name: Language-plus-shift compound penalty
developmentBacklogAdded.problem: Roles with both B2/C1 language requirements and evening/weekend shift burden can rank too high when penalties are scored independently.
developmentBacklogAdded.improvement: Apply a compound mismatch penalty when a language level above the target and undesirable shift pattern occur together, preventing nominal support fit from masking practical unsuitability.
